subject: CAIQ questionnaire — runtime isolation artifacts & delivery schedule
messages:
From: Anita Rao <anita.rao@novumcare.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: security@novumcare.com
Date: Sat, 4 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: CAIQ questionnaire — initial scope and evidence ask

Hi Lukas,

Thanks for agreeing to help us with the CAIQ responses. We started our intake for the NovumCare assessment and need a compact evidence set to validate a handful of controls related to runtime isolation and tenant boundaries. Specifically we're trying to cover: CCM-01 (tenant isolation), CCM-09 (keystore management), and CCM-23 (audit/logging for inference runtime).

What we need from you to start: 
- A one-page control-to-evidence index for the three controls above (CSV or spreadsheet is fine).
- A sample of runtime logs showing tenant labeling and access events (last 30 days) — a redacted sample is acceptable.
- Short statements identifying the control owner(s) for each sub-control.
- Proposed delivery schedule and preferred transfer mechanism (Google Drive link or SFTP).

I've attached our working CAIQ file (NovumCare_CAIQ_v2.xlsx) with the sections we care about highlighted. If you need to scope to Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private, call that out — NovumCare is Hosted-only for our initial proof-of-concept.

Could you confirm owners and an estimated delivery window by EOD tomorrow (our audit window opens next week).

Thanks,
Anita Rao
Security Programs 
NovumCare

-- Attachment: NovumCare_CAIQ_v2.xlsx (xlsx) --

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@novumcare.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 4 Jul 2026 12:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: CAIQ questionnaire — initial scope and evidence ask

Hi Anita — thanks for the clear ask and the highlighted spreadsheet. We can handle this scope for Hosted-only as you noted. Quick plan below and owners: 

- Ownership: Kimberly Park will be primary evidence owner for tenant isolation and keystore artifacts. Marissa Cole will manage uploads and the evidence bundle. I'll coordinate logging samples and attestations.
- Deliverables (proposed):
  1) Control-to-evidence index (CSV) — ETA: 3 business days (2026-07-07)
  2) Redacted runtime log sample (tar.gz) covering tenant labeling and access events — ETA: 3 business days (2026-07-07)
  3) Signed owner statements for sub-controls (PDF) — ETA: 7 business days (2026-07-12)

We prefer delivering via a shared Google Drive folder (we'll create a tenant-scoped folder and share a link + ACL list). If you require SFTP, we can support that but it takes additional coordination with our infra team.

Couple of clarifying questions: 
- When you say "runtime logs", do you need full traces (span-level) or just access/authorization events? We generally provide access events and keystore access metadata for CAIQ evidence.
- Are there any redaction rules we should follow beyond removing personal data?

I'll attach a quick mapping plan so you have visibility on what we'll include.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

-- Attachment: redwood-caiq-mapping-plan.pdf (pdf) --

Thanks Lukas — that timeline looks good and aligns with our intake. To confirm scope: Hosted API only (no Dedicated or Private environments). For logs, we only need access/authorization events (not full trace spans) — tenant id, timestamp, actor, action, and event outcome are sufficient. Redaction: strip any PII and replace tenant IDs with hashed tokens if present.

I've created a Drive folder and dropped a few reference items (see link below) and opened a HubSpot case HS-78291. Please use the Drive link for initial uploads; we'll switch to our secure intake if we need SFTP later.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NovumCareCAIQ
HubSpot case: HS-78291

Can you include an estimated delivery date for the owner statements (the PDF attestations)? We need those for audit scheduling.

Best,
Anita

Hi Anita — looping in a few specifics and a delivery schedule.

Per Lukas' plan, we will provide the following:
- 1x control-to-evidence index (CSV): includes links to artifacts and short notes for each mapped sub-control.
- 1x runtime log sample: hosted-runtime-log-sample.tar.gz — redacted (PII removed) and hashed tenant ids.
- 3x owner attestations (PDF) for the three sub-controls.
- 1x CAIQ crosswalk (simple XLSX) with our reference citations for each question.

Planned delivery (via Drive link you provided):
- 2026-07-07: control-to-evidence index + runtime log sample (initial drop)
- 2026-07-12: owner attestations + CAIQ crosswalk (final drop)

Upload notes: Marissa will create a tenant-scoped folder and set viewer access to the security@novumcare.com list. We will also place a small README in the folder describing redaction steps and a contact for follow-ups.

Attachments we will include in the Drive folder: caiq-ownership-checklist.csv, hosted-runtime-log-sample.tar.gz, redwood-owner-attestation-templates.pdf

If that schedule looks good, we'll proceed. If you need the owner attestation earlier, let us know and we'll try to accelerate.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Control Owner, Evidence Intake
Redwood Inference
